subject: Observability credits & SKU synthesis for retention / tracing / dashboards
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@atlashealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on retention/tracing/dashboard pricing + pilot credits

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the dashboards looked promising. Procurement pushed me to get an explicit breakdown of the observability add-ons (retention, tracing ingest/egress, advanced dashboards) so they can budget for the pilot. A few specific asks: 

- Can you provide a SKU-level workbook that shows per-GB/month retention tiers, tracing ingest vs egress billing, and dashboard seats/query units?
- For a short pilot (3 months) can we get a one-time credit or % discount applied to the add-ons? Our finance prefers credits applied to the first invoice rather than an up-front rebate.
- If we move to a 12-month commit after pilot, what ongoing tier discounts would you offer?
- Lastly, procurement needs SOC 2 Type II evidence and an initial SOW to review.

Timeline: procurement wants preliminary numbers by end of next week (Jun 21). Is that feasible?

Appreciate any fast turnaround — happy to jump on 30 minutes if useful.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lim
Director, Cloud Platform
AtlasHealth

Attachments: none

Ben / Rachel — forwarding AtlasHealth's asks below. Procurement wants SKU-level workbook + SOW by 21 Jun. Can we: 

- Ben: draft a pricing workbook with slabs and a pilot credit proposal (they prefer credits on first invoice). Include a 3-month pilot concession and a 12-month commit path.
- Rachel: quick confirm on tracing billing model (we typically bill ingest + query egress per million spans; clarify sample rates and any egress credits). Also please pull the SOC 2 pointer for them.

Thanks,

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Questions on retention/tracing/dashboard pricing + pilot credits

Team — attached is a first-pass workbook (pricing-model-internal.xlsx). Key commercial suggestions: 

- Retention: slab tiers by GB/month — 0-5TB @ $120/GB-month (pilot list), 5-50TB @ $85/GB-month, >50TB custom. For pilot we can apply a 40% effective pilot discount (implemented as a one-time credit equal to 40% of expected first-invoice add-on charges) — aligns with earlier concessions for similar accounts.
- Tracing: bill ingest (spans) at $0.015/1k spans + egress/query at $0.05/1k queries. Offer 100k tracing credits for pilot (covering expected sampling during POC).
- Dashboards: seat-based $120/seat/mo + $0.01/query-unit. For pilot: 3 seats included, plus 500k query-units credit.
- Commit path: if they move to 12-month reserved capacity we can reduce retention pricing by 10% and provide ongoing 10% off add-ons.

Proposed pilot concession: one-time credit covering ~25-40% (final depends on their expected usage profile). If procurement pushes for a % discount instead of credit we can convert to a 25% off invoice for first 90 days.

I've flagged lines where we should ask finance/sales ops for approvals (pilot % and total credit cap).

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-model-internal.xlsx

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@atlashealth.com>
Cc: AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — pilot proposal and SOW

Hi Sara / Procurement team,

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is our workbook (AH-pricing-proposal.xlsx) and a draft SOW (SOW-AtlasHealth-v1.pdf) for review. Highlights / proposed structure: 

1) Retention (logs/metrics/traces stored): tiered GB/month model with simple slabs. For the pilot we propose a one-time credit equal to 30% of anticipated add-on charges (applied to the first invoice). If AtlasHealth moves to a 12-month commit after pilot we would transition to the committed slab pricing (an additional 10% off list prices).

2) Tracing: ingest billed per 1k spans; egress/query billed per 1k queries. For the pilot we will include 50k spans credit and 200k query-unit credit (to cover sampling variability during POC).

3) Advanced dashboards: includes 3 seats during pilot + dashboard query credits. Post-pilot we propose seat pricing with a seat discount tier if >25 seats.

4) SOC 2: attached link in SOW; we can provide a scanned SOC 2 Type II report under NDA.

Next steps I suggest:
- Procurement confirm whether they prefer (a) one-time credit applied to invoice or (b) % discount on invoice. We accommodated credits above but can reformat.
- If acceptable, please review SOW redlines and we will route final via DocuSign.

Attached files: AH-pricing-proposal.xlsx, SOW-AtlasHealth-v1.pdf

Would you be available Thu 18 Jun at 10am PT for 30 minutes to walk through workbook?

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: AH-pricing-proposal.xlsx; SOW-AtlasHealth-v1.pdf

From: AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — pilot proposal and SOW

Hi Mateo / Sara,

Thanks for the materials — workbook looks tidy and SOW is a good start. A few asks from finance/procurement before we can sign: 

1) Discount: finance is requesting a 30% concession on add-on charges for the pilot (applied to invoices for the first 90 days). They prefer a % discount vs a one-time credit for accounting reasons. Can you accommodate 30% instead of 30% equivalent credit?

2) Credits timing: finance wants any credits/discounts to be applied across the first two invoices (roughly first 60 days) rather than a single invoice.

3) Seats: can the 3 pilot seats be converted to a 6-month reduced seat-rate if we extend to proof-level usage? They prefer stepped down seat fees vs immediate full price.

4) SOC 2: please provide the Type II scan (we can accept NDA).

We'd like a revised SOW and a simple term sheet that enumerates the pilot % and mechanism (invoice discount vs credit) — procurement needs that to sign off.

Regards,
AtlasHealth Procurement
procurement@atlashealth.com

Attachments: none

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Sara Lim <sara@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — pilot proposal and SOW (revised term sheet)

Hi procurement team / Sara — appreciate the clarity and timeline. We can accommodate most of your asks with a small commercial tradeoff: 

- Pilot discount: we can convert the pilot concession to a 28% invoice discount applied across the first two invoices (approx first 60 days). We cannot go to 30% without a 24-month commit given our current pricing guardrails; 28% is the max we can approve for a 90-day/60-day two-invoice spread without a longer-term lock.
- Seat conversion: we will convert the 3 pilot seats to a 6-month reduced seat-rate at 15% off list if you elect to continue after pilot (applies months 1–6 post-pilot).
- Tracing credits: we'll increase tracing/queries credits to cover 75k spans and 250k query-units for pilot coverage.
- SOC 2: Rachel attached the SOC 2 pointer to the SOW and we will provide the actual Type II scan under NDA — I'll route an NDA if needed.

I've attached a revised term sheet and an updated SOW (SOW-AtlasHealth-v1.pdf). If this sounds good I'll send a DocuSign link for signature (we can also accept PO if that's preferred).

Next steps: let me know if procurement accepts 28% across two invoices and the seat concession; if yes I'll issue DocuSign.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-AtlasHealth-v1.pdf; AH-pricing-proposal.xlsx; DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/execute/ZX9X-AtlasHealth-AH059
